name: Rimuru Tempest - Aurora
creator: magnaplayer
description:
**What if the founder of Tempest took Aurora's place on the Rift?**

This mod replaces Aurora with Rimuru Tempest from That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime. The mod features a custom character model along with animation adjustments made to better suit Rimuru's appearance and proportions.

Several animations have been edited and adapted by hand to work with the model. While some animations may look slightly different from the original champion, every effort was made to create a fun and fitting experience.

Whether you're a longtime Tensura fan or simply want a fresh way to play Aurora, Rimuru brings a unique look to the champion while preserving the original gameplay.
